mission_01: For local training, copy the global weights and run standard SGD: w = w - lr * gradient for each epoch
The FedAvg weighted average is: global_w[key] = sum(n_k * client_w[k][key]) / sum(n_k) where n_k is the number of samples on client k
Make sure to aggregate each weight matrix separately: the keys of the weight dictionary should match across all clients
